paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R (2008-2011 cars require an OEM strut bar; RHD may need mounting modifications) Part Type: PCV catch can kit, Fluid Lock Part Number: 20-0565-FL

The Radium Engineering PCV Catch Can Kit for the R35 GT-R installs a single catch can inline between the PCV valve and the intake manifold (vacuum side). It mounts in the left-hand side of the engine bay near the brake master cylinder at the rear of the engine compartment.
hl: 10AN ORB Ports: Large inlet and outlet ports
4AN ORB Drain Port: For an optional petcock drain
O-Ring Sealed Dipstick: Check the level without removing the can
Fluid Lock: Radium's patented system stops the reservoir overfilling into the intake
